signal_or_failure: Another club reports an APPLE in inventory and the designer driving it to a meeting
what_it_demonstrated: A working 6502 unit existed and attracted an outside club's request for a demonstration
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Any sale, order, or company-level act
notes: Earliest dated artifact naming product and founder together outside the founders' own assertion

signal_or_failure: Computer Mart of New York advertises the Apple-1
what_it_demonstrated: A multi-line East Coast retailer judged the machine worth advertising nine months before the maker advertised at all
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That Apple sold it, or that he was an authorized dealer (his own dealer list excludes Apple)
notes: Earliest print naming the product for sale; D L-4 bars dealer-network framing for 1976

signal_or_failure: Berkeley mail-order house offers the Apple-1 at 10% off the manufacturer's current list
what_it_demonstrated: A manufacturer's list price existed and circulated; the machine was shippable to strangers on standard hobby terms
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: What the list price was; that anyone bought
notes: Pivotal rung: the strongest price evidence in the window is an absent number

signal_or_failure: Founders demonstrate the Apple-II prototype to BYTE's editor and program on it live
what_it_demonstrated: The successor was running with a usable 5K integer BASIC environment
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Commercial validation; a publication commitment; observer neutrality (he was a friend of the subjects)
notes: Single witness, published within five months; relationship priced into provenance

signal_or_failure: "Apple Computers" on the committed exhibitor list for the first West Coast Computer Faire
what_it_demonstrated: The venture committed money and calendar to a public trade appearance before the window closed
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the booth materialised; what was shown; what it cost
notes: Only forward-looking organisational act visible in 1976 print

what_it_demonstrated: A legal form change - the stage's hardest date
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Capital, control, officers, purpose, or any operational change
notes: Two documents of unrelated lineage; charter text unreached; the incorporation month's club print is silent
